kd_d7_lag_days.reason: How many days after an hour of critical-shear exceedance the depth prediction looks for degraded clarity: a design choice for the test on the D7 draft, not a measured settling time.

kd_d7_deep_m.reason: The bed depth, in metres, beyond which a station is a deep control for the D7 depth prediction: a design choice, taken at an edge of the bottom-depth bands light.py already reports Secchi censoring in, leaving a band between the arms.

kd_d7_relax_days.reason: How many days after an exceedance the D7 relaxation prediction follows the coefficient: a design choice, long enough for a storm's effect to fade and short enough not to reach the next season.

kd_d7_shift_days.reason: The largest extra shift, in days, added to a whole-year circular shift in the D7 time null: a design choice, large enough to move a storm off its visits and small enough to keep the season.

kd_d7_nbhd_km.reason: The radius, in kilometres, of the neighbourhood within which the D7 depth null permutes bottom depth: a design choice, keeping a permuted station in comparable exposure while leaving stations to exchange with.
